name: Voxel Raycasting with DDA and Vertical Stripe Rendering
definition: A real-time rendering technique for 3D voxel grids that uses a 2D Digital Differential Analyzer (DDA) to cast rays per screen column, determining the first occupied voxel. It renders the voxel as a vertical stripe (line) rather than a full textured quad, handling depth via a per-column depth buffer to support multiple voxels per column (stacking).
